Rewrite it as $5x + 7 - 2x - 3$, then combine like terms.

alternativeExplanations.title: Take away stickers
steps: Peel off 2 x-stickers and 3 dot-stickers — take BOTH kinds away.
You are left with 3 x-stickers and 4 dots: 3x + 4.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check with a value
steps: And 3x + 4 at x = 10 is 30 + 4 = 34. The forms match, so 3x + 4 is right.
